objectives.text: the authenticity of communications sessions is protected

requirements.title: Data at Rest
requirements.statement: Protect the confidentiality of CUI at rest.

objectives.text: the confidentiality of CUI at rest is protected

requirements.title: Flaw Remediation [CUI Data]
requirements.statement: Identify, report, and correct system flaws in a timely manner.

objectives.text: the time within which to identify system flaws is specified
system flaws are identified within the specified time frame
the time within which to report system flaws is specified
system flaws are reported within the specified time frame
the time within which to correct system flaws is specified
system flaws are corrected within the specified time frame

requirements.title: Malicious Code Protection [CUI Data]
requirements.statement: Provide protection from malicious code at designated locations within organizational systems.

objectives.text: designated locations for malicious code protection are identified
protection from malicious code at designated locations is provided

requirements.title: Security Alerts & Advisories
requirements.statement: Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response.

objectives.text: response actions to system security alerts and advisories are identified
system security alerts and advisories are monitored
actions in response to system security alerts and advisories are taken

requirements.title: Update Malicious Code Protection [CUI Data]
requirements.statement: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.

objectives.text: malicious code protection mechanisms are updated when new releases are available

requirements.title: System & File Scanning [CUI Data]
requirements.statement: Perform periodic scans of organizational systems and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.

objectives.text: the frequency for malicious code scans is defined
malicious code scans are performed with the defined frequency
real-time malicious code scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed are performed

requirements.title: Monitor Communications for Attacks
requirements.statement: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.

objectives.text: the system is monitored to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks
inbound communications traffic is monitored to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks
outbound communications traffic is monitored to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks

requirements.title: Identify Unauthorized Use
requirements.statement: Identify unauthorized use of organizational systems.

objectives.text: authorized use of the system is defined
unauthorized use of the system is identified
